assay: bulk RNA-seq, gastrocnemius, STAR mm10 + featureCounts Ensembl 100 gene counts, non-mitochondrial genes (S2.10.p1)
sample_inclusion: n = 3-4 randomly selected per group for RNA-seq (S2.9.p1)
Low Run n=4, High Run n=4, controls n=3-4 (FIG6 legend)

factors.name: Run
levels: Run (2 bouts downhill running, harvest 24 h later)

primary_estimand: Effect of downhill running stress (24 h after 2 bouts) on gastrocnemius gene expression, within Low- and High-frailty aged female mice, and how it differs between them (Frailty x Run)

planned_contrast_labels.run_run_vs_sed_frail-low: Low Run vs Low Control (LR vs LC): running effect in Low-frailty mice
planned_contrast_labels.run_run_vs_sed_frail-high: High Run vs High Control (HR vs HC): running effect in High-frailty mice
planned_contrast_labels.frail_run_high_run_vs_low_sed: Frailty x Run interaction: (HR - HC) - (LR - LC)

blocking_or_covariance.note: independent animals, one gastrocnemius per mouse; no batch reported

matrix_scale: featureCounts raw gene counts (S2.10.p1); VST matrix also deposited
paper_method: DESeq2 (R 1.23.10 per paper / 1.32.0 per GEO) Wald test, two-factor model (Frailty, Run) with pairwise comparisons; BH FDR
paper_formula: two-factor model with interaction (coefficients Frailty, Run, Frailty x Run) - exact formula not printed (S2.10.p2)

paper_threshold.note: 'DEGs were determined at an FDR q < 0.1'; no fold-change cutoff stated

paper_reported_deg_counts: not_reported in the main text (DEG lists in Supplemental Tables 1-2, not available here)

HR_vs_HC.claim: DEGs at FDR q < 0.1 unique to the High group (S3.5.p3, FIG6e)

paper_enrichment.GSEA: GSEA 2.2.1 preranked by Wald stat, MSigDB 2024.1.Mm H, M2 CP, M5; FDR q < 0.05 (S2.10.p2); 284 sets with Frailty x Run interaction; top: OXPHOS / ATP biosynthesis / complex I assembly, up in LR vs LC and down in HR vs HC (S3.5.p1-p2)
paper_enrichment.ORA: DAVID EASE < 0.05 on HR vs HC and LR vs LC DEG lists; inflammation pathways only in High (S3.5.p3)
